name: Internships
description: New international software internships from the speedyapply 2027 list, filtered to EMEA (or any region). Unread postings are marked and counted; click one to open it.
author: AmineChr54

include.label: Also include
include.hint: Countries or cities outside the region, comma separated. Example: Singapore, Toronto

exclude.label: Exclude
exclude.hint: Countries or cities to hide, comma separated. Example: Poland, Zürich

keywords.label: Keywords
keywords.hint: Show only postings whose company or role contains any of these, comma separated. Example: software, ml

remote.label: Include plain remote roles
remote.hint: Remote roles with no country can't be matched to a region.
